name: Public Works Department (Buildings and Roads), Punjab
summary: The state department that builds and maintains Punjab's state highways, major district roads and bridges.
about: Punjab has one of the densest state road networks in India, laid across flat, intensively farmed land. Its Public Works Department maintains the state highways and district roads that carry the state's grain to market and its people between a close-set string of towns.
facts: Responsible for Punjab's state highways and major district roads.
Also looks after most state-owned bridges and government buildings.
National highways in the state are not its responsibility — those belong to NHAI, NHIDCL or the state's national highway wing.
